sloka: ततः प्रजवनाश्वेन रथेन रथिनां वरः ।हरीनभ्यहनत् क्रोधाच्छरजालैरकम्पनः ।। ६.५६.६ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ prajavanāśvena rathena rathināṁ varaḥ ।harīnabhyahanat krodhāccharajālairakampanaḥ ।। 6.56.6 ।।।।

translations.english: Then Akampana seated in the chariot drawn by fast moving horses, assailed the Vanaras with a network of arrows.
